summary: Examples: an ad-hoc ping of webservers, a ping task in a playbook, and inducing an exception with data: crash.
questions: How do I ping a group from the command line?
How do I test error handling with ping?

answer_card.title: ping examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```
ansible webservers -m ansible.builtin.ping
```
```yaml
- ansible.builtin.ping:
- ansible.builtin.ping: {data: crash}
```
